name: trialagents-pipeline
description: Track biotech programs, milestones, activities, decisions, deliverables, risks and changes in an interactive team workspace.

interface.longDescription: Track biotech programs, milestones, decisions and risks in a shared workspace. Connect your TrialAgents account to save and revisit your work. Owners manage the workspace structure and can invite teammates in workspaces with invitations enabled. Editors can update records and save shared views.
defaultPrompt: Show my pipeline and the milestones due next.
Create a saved view of planned activities in my workspace.
Show the dependencies for my selected milestone.

positive.prompt: Which EX-101 milestone is due next?
positive.expected_behavior: Open once with the matching milestone and date.

positive.prompt: Move the EX-101 protocol review milestone to 15 December 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the requested record. On a follow-up answer without reopening.

positive.prompt: Create a Committees table with a Name field. Each decision should link to one committee.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one table with a many-to-one relationship from Decision.

positive.prompt: Save a view called Upcoming decisions by committee.
positive.expected_behavior: Present the saved view once and open the same view from its web link.

positive.prompt: Archive the Legacy code column in Committees and show what it affects.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify affected views, resolve impact and archive the selected column.

negative.description: Offer reversible archive. Leave definitions untouched.
negative.prompt: Permanently drop the Committees table and erase its columns.
As an editor, add a column to Decisions for everyone.

negative.description: Outside Pipeline operational planning. No research or email action.
negative.prompt: Find recruiting lung-cancer trial sites in Germany and email their contacts.

review.commerce_description: The plugin supports account linking, saved workspace data and team collaboration where the owner has invitation permission. The Open TrialAgents app action opens the user’s workspace. The plugin has no purchase, subscription, upgrade or checkout flow.

publication.release_notes: First release of the connected Pipeline workspace, record management, shared custom views and owner customization.
